title: Cumulative Updates for Business Central – versions
summary: This post lists cumulative updates available for all versions of Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises, from version 29 (2026 wave 2) through version 13 (2018 wave 2). Updates include hotfixes for all countries and localized versions, with the latest updates recommended to address vulnerabilities and bugs.
key_points: Cumulative updates replace previously released updates for each Business Central version
Latest updates should always be installed as they fix vulnerabilities
Updates include both global hotfixes and localization-specific fixes
Currently supported versions range from v29 (2026 wave 2) down to v20 (2022 wave 1), with older versions no longer receiving updates
Versions v25-v14 are listed as no longer updated but historical records are available
